title: Ceasefire threatened: Iran accuses U.S. of violating ceasefire, closes Strait of Hormuz again
text: Ceasefire threatened: Iran accuses U.S. of violating ceasefire, closes Strait of Hormuz againA ceasefire deal to pause the war in Iran appeared to hang by a thread on Wednesday after the Islamic Republic closed the Strait of Hormuz again in response to Israeli attacks in Lebanon.
